subject: Privacy intake & procurement onboarding — Acme Analytics
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jill Huang <jill.huang@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Privacy intake & procurement onboarding — Acme Analytics

Hi Jill,

Thanks again for agreeing to work with Redwood. We're starting the vendor onboarding/procurement process and I wanted to kick off the privacy and commercial intake so we can get to PO issuance quickly. Attached is our standard onboarding checklist to speed things up. For the privacy/compliance side we need the following from Acme: 

- Executable DPA (or a DPA draft you would like us to review). Please indicate acceptance of Redwood's DPA or share your proposed edits.
- Full subprocessor roster (CSV preferred) with vendor name, role, and hosting region(s).
- Data retention policy describing retention periods for logs, request/response data, and backups.
- Any SOC 2 or ISO attestation (if available).
- Contact for security/incident response (name + email).

On the procurement side: 
- W-9 or tax equivalent, remittance details (bank wiring instructions or AP contact), and whether you require a purchase order or accept invoices net30.

Target timeline: if possible, please return the docs within 5 business days so we can route to Legal and Finance. If you have a vendor portal or onboarding form you'd prefer we use, share the link and we'll follow that flow.

Thanks — happy to set a 30-minute sync this week if that's easier.

Best,
Priyom Das
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
redwoodinference.com
Attachment: redwood_onboarding_checklist.pdf (PDF, 56 KB)

From: Jill Huang <jill.huang@acme-analytics.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-analytics.com, security@acme-analytics.com
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 19:45:22 -0800
Subject: Re: Privacy intake & procurement onboarding — Acme Analytics

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for the clear list. Attached are the items you requested: our standard DPA draft, a CSV of current subprocessors, our data retention policy, and a completed W-9. Quick answers inline below to help Legal/Finance triage: 

- DPA: attached (acme_DPA_draft.pdf). We're generally happy to sign Redwood's DPA but include a couple of minor redline suggestions around liability caps and standard indemnities — nothing we consider blocking.
- Subprocessors: attached (acme_subprocessors.csv). We use AWS (us-east-1, us-west-2) and Cloudflare for CDN. Full list shows third-party analytics and monitoring vendors; locations are in the third column.
- Retention: attached (acme_data_retention_policy.pdf). By default we retain request logs for 90 days; aggregated metrics retained for 2 years. We do not persist unhashed PII beyond processing unless contractually required.
- SOC 2: we completed SOC 2 Type II in 2024; summary available on request.
- Security contact: Marcus Li, security@acme-analytics.com.
- Billing: we accept PO or invoice; default terms Net30. AP contact is ap@acme-analytics.com and preferred invoice delivery is invoices@acme-analytics.com.

We'll also include a bank remittance CSV in a follow-up email for Finance.

Let me know if you need subprocessors' geographic breakdown (EU/UK locations noted in the CSV) or a signed copy of the DPA first. Happy to get the DPA countersigned in parallel with PO.

Best,
Jill Huang
Head of Partnerships
Acme Analytics
Attachment: acme_DPA_draft.pdf (PDF, 132 KB); acme_subprocessors.csv (CSV, 8 KB); acme_data_retention_policy.pdf (PDF, 24 KB); acme_w9.pdf (PDF, 42 KB)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jill Huang <jill.huang@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 08:10:05 -0800
Subject: Re: Privacy intake & procurement onboarding — Acme Analytics

Jill —

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments. A few clarifying items from Legal and Finance reviewers: 

1) EU/UK data transfers: Legal asked for explicit subprocessors' hosting locations for EU data (we saw some entries in the CSV but would like a short column confirming whether the subprocessor processes EU data or only US/ROW). Can you add a column "EU Processing: yes/no"?

2) DPA: Laura will propose minor wording for the Security and Data Transfer clauses. Are you able to accept Redwood's standard EU Addendum or do you require the countersigned version of your draft first?

3) Billing & PO: Finance noted you accept PO/Net30 — good. Please include the remit-to address or bank details in the bank remittance CSV you mentioned so we can create the vendor record. If you prefer, we can send a PO once the DPA is agreed.

4) SOC 2: if possible, please share the SOC 2 report or a SOC 2 summary letter (redacted is fine) — we'll treat that as evidence for security review.

If you can return the updated CSV with the EU-processing flag and indicate whether you'll sign our DPA (or provide a track-changes version), we can target PO issuance the week of Feb 16.

Thanks — copying Laura for legal context. If easier, happy to do a 30-min call.

Best,
Priyom
Attachment: (none)

From: Jill Huang <jill.huang@acme-analytics.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@acme-analytics.com, Marcus Li <security@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 18:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Privacy intake & procurement onboarding — Acme Analytics

Priyom / Laura —

Thanks — attached is an updated subprocessor CSV with an "EU Processing" column. We reviewed Redwood's DPA and can sign with two minor edits to the liability section; Marcus (cc'd) confirmed security language is acceptable.

I also uploaded our GDPR addendum here for your review: https://acme.example.com/gdpr-addendum (attaching acme_gdpr_addendum.pdf as well). We will return a countersigned DPA via DocuSign within 48 hours. Our bank remittance details are in the attached CSV (acme_bank_remittance_details.csv).

If you want the PO before countersignature we can accept in parallel; otherwise we'll wait for the signed DPA and then you can issue the PO.

Happy to jump on a quick call next week if helpful.

Best regards,
Jill
Attachment: acme_subprocessors_updated.csv (CSV, 9 KB); acme_gdpr_addendum.pdf (PDF, 58 KB); acme_bank_remittance_details.csv (CSV, 3 KB)
